_comment: OPTIONAL per-source ranking boost for the secondary corpus (textbook_search). Map a source/book folder name to a similarity bonus added before reranking — use it to float your most trusted/authoritative sources to the top. Point VAULT_SEARCH_SOURCE_BOOST at a copy of this file. The folder names below are just illustrative examples (a PM&R reference set); replace them with your own. Suggested tiers: primary refs ~0.06-0.08, specialty refs ~0.03-0.05.
